about: Amoxliatl (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Amoxliatl), as captured in her chamber beneath the Ruins of Tapoyauik (rsprox captures 1147 and 1695): the door, the instance, the fight and the kill. Tiles are absolute, on the cache map; the instance copies them. See docs/amoxliatl.md.

door.about: vmq3_ruins_door_multi: the Frozen door until The Heart of Darkness is done (varbit 11117), then 'Door' with Pass-through.

instance.about: As captured: the whole of map square 5446 (8x8 chunks), plane 0, unturned.

exits.question: Are you sure you want to exit?

fade.about: As captured, in and out alike: the fade out, the minimap off a tick later, the move at 2, the fade back in at 4 and the overlay closed at 6.

spawn.say: Euat! You are not welcome here!

arena.about: The platform her spikes cover (every tile they were seen on), as rows of [y, minX, maxX], and the 3-wide path east to the ice blockage. Its centre plays the pools' sound.

spikes.about: Map animations on tiles around the player, as captured: the player's own tile about 3 in 4, the tiles next to it about 2 in 3, the rest out to 6 about 1 in 4. 3 ticks after the attack they come up: typeless damage to a player still on one (captured 10 and 6; 6-10 as the Wiki gives the pools).

pools.about: An icy pool on the player's tile 3 ticks after each standard attack (captured); standing on one deals 6-10 a tick (Wiki). They stay until she dies, then go with a puff (captured).

specials.about: After every 2-4 standard attacks a special; the first at random, then in turn (Wiki). From the path she only has room for Icicle Crash.

icicle.message: <col=ff3045>Amoxliatl disables your prayers and launches an icicle attack!</col>

unstableIce.message: <col=00ffff>Amoxliatl forms some unstable ice blocks around you.

kill.about: As captured: the pools go on the killing blow; 2 ticks later (deathTicks) the kill count, the fight's length and the loot on her middle tile.
